# Mountain Ceramics Company

> Mountain Ceramics Company (MCC) is a tile manufacturer in Rwanda. This file describes public company pages and public API endpoints for AI assistants and other automated clients.

## Store

- Public storefront pages are available in English, French, and Kinyarwanda.
- Browse tile products, collections, catalogues, projects, and store information.
- Read current company announcements and documents on the publications page.
- Product and variant details, availability, and prices are provided by the store; use the latest product data rather than inferring stock or prices.
- Product listings show starting prices per square metre when a priced active variant exists. For exact size, finish, price, currency, and availability, query the product API rather than relying on a page summary.
- Guest checkout is available. Do not require an account to place an order.

## Public pages

- Home: [Home](https://mountainceramic.com/)
- Products: [Products](https://mountainceramic.com/products)
- Collections: [Collections](https://mountainceramic.com/collections)
- Catalogues: [Catalogues](https://mountainceramic.com/catalogue)
- Projects: [Projects](https://mountainceramic.com/projects)
- Blog: [Blog](https://mountainceramic.com/blog)
- Publications and company announcements: [Publications](https://mountainceramic.com/publications)
- Contact: [Contact](https://mountainceramic.com/contact)
- Tile visualizer: [Visualizer](https://mountainceramic.com/visualizer)
- Legal documents: [Terms and Conditions](https://mountainceramic.com/legal/terms-and-conditions), [Terms of Service](https://mountainceramic.com/legal/terms-of-service), [Privacy Policy](https://mountainceramic.com/legal/privacy-policy)

English is the default locale and does not use a URL prefix. Add `/fr` or `/rw` before a page path to browse in French or Kinyarwanda. The store sitemap is available at [XML sitemap](https://mountainceramic.com/sitemap.xml).

## Discovery and app resources

- XML sitemap: [Sitemap](https://mountainceramic.com/sitemap.xml) (includes public products, published blog posts, active publications, and legal pages).
- Crawler rules: [robots.txt](https://mountainceramic.com/robots.txt).
- Web app manifest: [manifest.webmanifest](https://mountainceramic.com/manifest.webmanifest).
- API catalog: [RFC 9727 API catalog](https://mountainceramic.com/.well-known/api-catalog).
- API schema: [OpenAPI document](https://mountainceramic.com/openapi.json).
- Agent capabilities: [AI catalog](https://mountainceramic.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json).
- Markdown pages: request a public page with `Accept: text/markdown`; ordinary browser requests continue to receive HTML.
- Agent browsing instructions: [Public store skill](https://mountainceramic.com/agent-skills/mcc-store/SKILL.md).
- Browser tools: On WebMCP-capable browsers, agents can search products, read product details, browse collections/catalogues, manage the local cart, and navigate public store pages. Contact submission requires explicit confirmation; checkout remains customer-reviewed.
- Authentication: [Agent authentication policy](https://mountainceramic.com/auth.md). Agent registration and OAuth/OIDC are not currently supported.
- Browser and home-screen icons use the Mountain Ceramics Company logo.

## Public API

- [`GET /api/products`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/products) — list and filter products.
- [`GET /api/products/{slug}`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/products/{slug}) — retrieve a product by its stable slug.
- [`GET /api/collections`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/collections) — list public collections.
- [`GET /api/catalogues`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/catalogues) — list public catalogues.
- [`GET /api/blog`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/blog) — list public blog posts.
- [`GET /api/publications`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/publications) — list currently active public publications.
- [`GET /api/visualizer-products`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/visualizer-products) — retrieve products available to the visualizer.
- [`GET /api/visualizer/scenes`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/visualizer/scenes) — retrieve visualizer scenes.
- [`GET /api/health`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/health) — check that the web service is responding.
- [`POST /api/checkout`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/checkout) — submit a guest or signed-in checkout; the server calculates order totals.
- [`POST /api/contact`](https://mountainceramic.com/api/contact) — submit a store enquiry.

For floor tiles, call `GET /api/products?category=floor&status=ACTIVE&limit=60`. Each product includes active `variants`; each priced variant reports `size`, `finish`, `pricePerSqm`, and `currency`. `pricePerSqm` is the price per square metre. For a single product, call `GET /api/products/{slug}` for the current variant availability too. If a browser tool refuses a product page or catalogue page, use these public API endpoints instead.

Use the API response as the source of truth for prices, availability, and product details. Do not infer missing prices or stock, and do not submit client-calculated totals as authoritative.
